status: Zero-exact material-normal representation correction; not a ground-band fix or final visual acceptance

retained_change.diagnostic_preview: tools/worldgen-rocky/examples/dump_material_pages.rs decodes SNORM to conventional RGB normal PNGs, with a three-case byte oracle
retained_change.old_format: RG8_UNORM; nominal flat [128,128] decodes to [1/255,1/255], approximately 0.318 degrees of artificial tilt
retained_change.new_format: RG8_SNORM; round(clamp(component,-1,1)*127) as i8 bytes; GPU signed decoding before filtering; no shader *2-1
retained_change.compatibility: Normal-bearing decoded/runtime pages now require signed bytes. Regenerate/re-encode old unsigned payloads; no format auto-detection. Normal-less pages, albedo/roughness, legacy RGBA normal exports and Bevy albedo-only path unchanged
